title: Decode CAN Control Frame
shortDescription: Decode mixed-endian fields from an 8-byte CAN control frame.

objectives: Decode mixed-endian fields from an 8-byte CAN control frame

hints.nudge: The two multi-byte fields do not use the same byte order.
hints.approach: Separate validation, checksum, and decoding. Label each byte with its significance for its own field, and reason about the signed torque word after reconstructing its bits.

templates.notes: Decode bytes explicitly; do not cast the payload to a struct.

visibleCases.name: valid command
visibleCases.displayExpect:
rc = 0
out.torque = 4660  // 0x1234
out.speed = 500
out.armed = true
out.fault = false
out.counter = 122  // 0x7A
visibleCases.explanation: The torque bytes 34 12 decode to 0x1234 (4660) in little-endian order; speed bytes 01 F4 decode to 500 in big-endian order. The XOR of bytes 0–6 is 0xA8.

visibleCases.name: negative torque
visibleCases.displayExpect:
rc = 0
out.torque = -123
out.speed = 100
out.armed = false
out.fault = false
out.counter = 2
visibleCases.explanation: The little-endian torque word is 0xFF85, which represents -123 as a signed 16-bit value. The checksum is 0x1C.

visibleCases.name: bad checksum
visibleCases.explanation: The payload requires checksum 0xA8, but its final byte is 0x00, so parsing returns -3. No decoded output fields are specified for this error.

hiddenCases.name: short payload
hiddenCases.explanation: CAN frame length must be validated.
